text:
Ava (CEO): Quick update for the week — three asks: 1) Private GA checklist final review by EOW (Priya + Eng leads). 2) SLA tightening: target p99 latency <= 220ms for small hosted requests; Jonas please propose rollback conditions. 3) Cost ops: target ~15% unit-cost reduction on heavy embedding workloads via batching/quant. Exec one-pager due Wed. Please read and ack.
Miguel (VP Eng): On it. I'll baseline current p99 and add a canary plan to the console. Looping infra in for kernel tuning.
Priya (VP Product): Private GA checklist status — most items green; docs + legal sign-off remain. Demo booked Thu 11:00 PT.
Jonas (Head of SRE): p99 plan: automated fallback to quantized variant + cross-region routing + KV-cache priming. Drafting rollback rules now.
Sam (Growth PM): For cost ops, can product flag cold prefixes or traffic slices? We can send sample segments for batching tests.
Ava (CEO): +1 Sam. Also tag any rollout that changes billing with label `billing-impact`.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: `dedicated-pool-v2` -> 30% at 2026-03-24T02:00Z.
Miguel (VP Eng): Small open question — burst capacity policy decision? It affects canary throughput and autoscaler limits.
Priya (VP Product): We'll sign off on burst policy if it includes automatic capacity reclaim and a hard cost cap. Adding to Thu agenda.
Lina (GC): Quick compliance hold — KMS integration for Private GA needs validation by Fri. Who owns verification?
Priya (VP Product): Legal + Security. Tagging @Jules to confirm checklist and ETA.
Jules (Security): Security will run the KMS checklist and audit key rotations; sending ETA EOD Friday.
Ava (CEO): Thanks everyone. Short metrics snapshot to share with execs: adoption +8% wk/wk; error rate ~0.20%; cost per 1k tokens down 3% since last sprint. Keep focus on reliability and cost. Please ack with :eyes: when you've read.
Miguel (VP Eng): :eyes:
Priya (VP Product): :thumbsup:
Jonas (Head of SRE): :white_check_mark:
Sam (Growth PM): :raising_hand:
Jules (Security): Will post KMS runbook link when complete.
Ava (CEO): Filing follow-ups: 1) Miguel to post p99 baseline + canary plan; 2) Jonas to publish rollback rules; 3) Priya to circulate Private GA one-pager and legal checklist. Thanks — short standup Mon to review progress.
